name: North Dakota Unified Spill Reporting System (HazConnect) public incident list
operator: ND Department of Environmental Quality / ND Department of Emergency Services (HazConnect, a vendor system)
access_detail: ASP.NET page behind Cloudflare bot protection (blocked from this machine 2026-11-03; raw/hz-list.html is the block page). DEQ says the tool searches by location, date, material type and responsible party. Needs a browser session or an agreement with DEQ/NDDES.
legal_basis: Spill reporting procedures (spill.nd.gov, 2021): immediate report where waterways are impacted or threatened or public health is affected
status_reason: The state's public list of every incident reported since 2021-01-01, linked from spill.nd.gov and DEQ's Spill Investigation page. Cloudflare returned 'Sorry, you have been blocked' to curl and 403 to WebFetch, so contents, fields and whether municipal sewage overflows are entered could not be confirmed.
notes: Local radio summaries of 2024 HazConnect months list oilfield and fuel incidents; no sewage rows seen there.

name: ND DEQ General Environmental Incidents - Historical (1975-2020)
operator: North Dakota Department of Environmental Quality
access_detail: ASP.NET WebForms table, 15 rows a page, postback search on TextBoxSearch (does not search dates). Individual report pages per Incident ID. Search results saved in raw/legacy-sewage-search.txt.
cadence: frozen; updated only for incidents still active at the 2021 transition
status_reason: Fetched: 4,452 records, each with incident id (EIR#####), dates reported and of incident, county, lat/long, contaminant, volume, units. A 'Sewage' search returned 31 records 2013-2020, mostly Grand Forks and Cass (Fargo) sanitary sewage spills up to 500,000 gallons. Frozen at 2020; history only.

name: ND DEQ Oilfield Environmental Incidents - Historical (1975-2020)
operator: ND DEQ (data from the Oil and Gas Division)

name: North Dakota unified spill/release reporting procedures (spill.nd.gov)
operator: State of North Dakota (DES, DEQ, Oil and Gas, Agriculture)
status_reason: Defines immediate reporting criteria (public health, waterways impacted or threatened, injuries, evacuations, wildlife). No public-notice duty for the reporter.

name: City of Fargo NDPDES permit ND0022870 (draft, public notice ND-2023-021)
status_reason: Special conditions 'Reporting, Record Keeping, and Public Notification for Unauthorized Sanitary Sewer Overflows': oral report to DEQ within 24 hours; plan for public notice; 'shall immediately notify the public, public health agencies, and other affected entities'. Channel is left to each permittee's plan.

name: ND DEQ harmful algal bloom advisories and warnings (Story Map and press releases)
operator: North Dakota Department of Environmental Quality
access_detail: Story Map item c875847d52864881a96cc591421cd1bc (owner DEQ-HAB); web map 49a8af8315f647ba86e89ea23a8c9269 has only an embedded Shortlist layer. Press releases are PDFs (e.g. deq.nd.gov/PressReleases/2026-08-28-639235102525368210.pdf).
status_reason: Advisory (bloom present) and warning (bloom over a significant portion and toxins above the recreational threshold) lists, 1 May to 31 Dec; 20 waterbodies by mid-September 2026. Published as a Story Map (updated 2026-10-08) and weekly PDF press releases at deq.nd.gov/PressReleases; the 2022 web map behind it is a Shortlist with no service URL. No feature service found.

name: Beach E. coli monitoring (state parks, lakes)
status_reason: No statewide public beach E. coli program or results page found (search only). Local health units or Parks and Recreation may sample individual beaches.

name: EPA ECHO sewer overflow and bypass event reports (eRule Phase 2, NeT-SewerOverflow), ND rows
operator: US EPA (ECHO); reports filed by permittees through NeT-SewerOverflow
waters_covered: statewide; receiving water free text in a child table (often blank)
access_detail: Daily ZIP from ECHO; table sewer_overflow_bypass_report_events.csv joined to sewer_overflow_bypass_receiving_waters.csv on sewer_overflow_bypass_event_key; filter permit_identifier prefix. Pipeline already has pipeline/ingest/echo_sewer_overflow_events.py. Trimmed sample in raw/sobe-sample.json.
cadence: Extract rebuilt daily; these are the 5-day written reports, so they appear days to weeks after the event (start-to-receipt median n/a).
history: Rows from April 2023 (NeT pilot) to date
license: EPA public data; no restriction stated
legal_basis: 40 CFR 127 (NPDES eRule Phase 2, from 2025-12-21); 40 CFR 122.41(l)(6) five-day written report
status_reason: 0 ND event(s) in the 2026-11-03 extract; the state's permittees do not file through NeT. North Dakota permittees report SSOs by phone and in writing to DEQ; ND does not appear to use NeT-SewerOverflow.

name: ND DEQ press releases (PDF)
operator: North Dakota Department of Environmental Quality
status_reason: HAB advisories weekly; occasional spill notices. PDF only, no feed found.

name: ECHO DMR monthly data for ND POTWs
status_reason: No CSO permits in ND, so no CSO event counts; SSOs are not DMR parameters.
